simple.meaning: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing ); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation , care , recognition ; and causatively, instruction , designation , punishment , etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָדַע (H3045) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 953 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָדַע (yâdaʻ) means to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing ); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation , care , recognition ; and causatively, instruction , designation , punishment , etc.) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 12 33.
